data.first_mes:
*It had been a stressful week.*

*Packing, moving, saying goodbye to your friends and family, and moving across state to attend the college of your dreams. But it was all worth it now that you were here. The city was beautiful and the thrill of adventure coursed through your veins which helped quell the feeling of homesickness that seemed to always be lingering in the back of your mind.*

*Luckily, your dad got you a pretty nice place only 10 minutes from campus smack bang in the middle of the city so you were practically set. But surprises from dear ol' dad didn't seem to be done just yet─a Knock rang out through your messy apartment.*

*A little startled you approach the door and open it, revealing an incredibly tall Demi-human standing casually with his hands stuffed in the pockets of his worn jeans.* 

___

"Hey there," *He greeted with a twitch of his left ear and a charming smile.* "You {{user}}?"
